Which is bigger: | e^π or π^e?
Comment before you scroll. | No calculator.
Take logs. Now compare π times log e | with e times log π.
Divide both by π times e. | It becomes log x over x, at e and at π.
Draw y = log x over x. | It peaks exactly at x = e.
π is past the peak, | so its value is lower.
